reason: The plugin’s primary user-facing purpose is to integrate a private or company OpenAI-compatible model endpoint into DSH as a selectable chat vendor, with optional forward proxy handling for request routing, so it is best classified as an external-service integration rather than a general utility.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于将 OpenAI 兼容的公司/私有模型服务接入 DSH，在界面新增模型厂商并支持按配置通过 HTTP(S) 正向代理转发请求。
summaries.en: This plugin adds an OpenAI-compatible company/private model provider to DSH, exposing it in the chat model selection flow and optionally forwarding requests through a configured HTTP(S) proxy.

reasons.code: The plugin explicitly documents registering an OpenAI-compatible provider (`openai-proxy`) and forwarding model calls through a configurable HTTP(S) proxy URL, so it actively routes outbound API traffic to external/private endpoints.
Configuration supports `apiKeyEnv` and settings storage for API keys, indicating dependency on bearer credentials for outbound LLM requests.
The package metadata exposes a web client/runtime integration bundle and includes `undici` for HTTP proxy-capable requests, confirming external service call behavior within DSH.
